name: Andrew Warring
html:
Andrew has a strong background in business growth and operational excellence. He champions safety, sustainability, and innovation, drawing on extensive experience in risk management and on-site construction. Andrew builds trust and loyalty with clients through clear communication and collaborative leadership.

At Green Hat, Andrew drives strategic development, invests in technology, and nurtures talent to support clients, teams, and communities. His leadership maximises client value while ensuring safety and compliance.

name: Jo Warring
html:
Jo brings a rich and varied background in healthcare, education and strategic communication, to the Green Hat team. With experience as a Licensed Acupuncturist, University Lecturer and NHS District Nursing Sister, alongside a Master’s in Medical Humanities and a Distinguished Teaching Award from Swansea University, Jo offers a unique perspective on organisational development.

At Green Hat, she supports the leadership team with policy writing, procedural documentation, and communication planning. Her strength lies in translating complex ideas into clear, practical solutions, ensuring consistency, professionalism, and alignment across the business. Jo’s calm leadership and collaborative approach make her an integral part of the team’s success.

name: Dan Gilbert
html:
Dan Gilbert combines on-site experience with a strong design background, giving him a deep understanding of the construction sector. His proactive approach to design look-aheads ensures buildability and promotes coordination among all parties.

Dan involves stakeholders at every stage of the build to achieve cost-effective, safe, and high-quality results. He excels at building relationships and uniting teams to deliver the best possible outcomes in every situation.

name: Koran Thomas
html:
Koran is our dynamic and visionary Associate Finance Director at Green Hat. She brings a wealth of expertise and a passion for excellence to the team. With qualifications including MAAT, MSc, and BSc (Hons), Koran safeguards the financial health of the business while driving strategic growth and innovation.

She is known for meticulous attention to detail and a forward-thinking approach. Koran has led numerous high-impact financial projects, ensuring compliance, optimising performance, and driving continuous improvement. Her dedication to accuracy, transparency, and collaboration makes her an invaluable part of the Green Hat leadership team.

name: Nathan Gough
html:
Nathan, our Associate Operations Director at Green Hat Consulting, brings a wealth of experience in risk management and operational leadership. His role focuses on promoting safety, sustainability, and efficiency across all projects, ensuring that every build meets the highest standards of quality and compliance.

With a strong background in on-site construction, Nathan understands the practical challenges teams face and works proactively to address them. He champions operational excellence by implementing best practices that reduce risk and improve performance. His commitment to sustainable methods reflects Green Hat’s vision for responsible and future-ready construction.

Nathan also plays a key role in strategic development. He drives business growth through innovative solutions and technology adoption, helping clients achieve long-term success. By fostering trust and loyalty, Nathan builds strong relationships with stakeholders and ensures exceptional service at every stage of the project lifecycle.

His leadership style is collaborative and client-focused. Nathan believes that clear communication and teamwork are essential for delivering safe, cost-effective, and high-quality outcomes. This approach makes him an invaluable part of Green Hat’s leadership team and a trusted partner for clients seeking operational excellence.

name: James Gregory
html:
James is a CDM Consultant at Green Hat Consulting. He works closely with project stakeholders to deliver Principal Designer services across residential, commercial, and educational projects. James plans, coordinates, and manages the pre-construction phase to embed health and safety considerations and ensure compliance with CDM Regulations at every stage.

He provides administrative support, prepares pre-construction information, and assists with developing Construction Phase Plans and Health and Safety Files. James takes a proactive, collaborative, and detail-oriented approach to every task. In addition, he focuses on identifying and managing design-related risks to promote safe and efficient project delivery.

James strives to facilitate collaboration between all parties. He is dedicated to continual professional development and brings a fresh, enthusiastic perspective to his work. His professional and personable approach helps him build positive relationships and contribute effectively to achieving the best outcomes for every project.

name: Tom Thiele
html:
Tom is our Lead Technical Consultant. As a Chartered Architectural Technologist, he brings nearly a decade of experience in technical design, project delivery, and multidisciplinary coordination. He specialises in helping project teams navigate Building Regulations requirements while maintaining high standards of safety, quality, and design excellence.

His background spans the full RIBA Plan of Work. This enables him to manage design risk, regulatory obligations, and quality standards from early concept through to final handover. Tom’s collaborative approach and attention to detail keep building safety, legal compliance, and technical standards front and centre.

Tom is passionate about precision and safety. He plays a key role in delivering compliant, high-quality, and future-ready buildings. His ability to bring clarity and confidence to complex design challenges is an essential part of our mission at Green Hat.

name: Sam Musgrave
html:
Sam is Green Hat Consulting’s Lead Building Regulations Consultant, specialising in Principal Designer Building Regulations (PD BR) services and Building Safety Act compliance. He has a background in architectural technology and design coordination and has worked on complex projects from concept through to completion.

Sam helps clients, designers, contractors, and other duty holders meet their responsibilities under the Building Regulations and Building Safety Act. He provides practical advice on compliance, design risk management, Gateway submissions, and regulatory requirements.

He takes a collaborative approach to project delivery and works closely with stakeholders throughout the design and construction process. His focus is on finding practical solutions that support compliance while helping projects move forward efficiently.

As a senior member of the team, Sam also supports Green Hat’s technical standards and continuous improvement initiatives. He shares knowledge with colleagues, contributes to best practice development, and helps maintain a consistent, high-quality service for clients.

name: Lauren Gower
html:
Lauren brings technical expertise, sustainability leadership, and a collaborative spirit to Green Hat Consulting. As one of the first architects to complete the government-sponsored Level 7 Degree Apprenticeship, Lauren gained broad experience across residential, commercial, and education projects.

Leading the technical delivery of the Harewood Junior Staffroom Extension, Lauren also contributed to innovative projects such as Passivhaus school buildings and BREEAM-accredited developments. A focus on building regulation compliance led Lauren to develop and audit processes like the Building Regulations Tracker, and to serve as a technical advisor to the Department for Education.

With a hands-on approach, Lauren excels in client engagement, community consultation, and mentoring young designers. Commitment to sustainability is evident in project work and leadership of internal sustainability groups, driving improvements in BIM workflows and environmental impact assessment.

At Green Hat, Lauren uses a data-driven mindset to safeguard quality and safety in the built environment. Clear and positive communication helps build strong relationships and ensures structured team interactions. This blend of design, technical delivery, and regulatory compliance makes Lauren a valuable asset to clients, teams, and the wider community.

name: Claudia Fernandes
html:
Claudia brings a wealth of experience in document control, health and safety, and commercial administration to Green Hat Consulting. With a strong background in construction and fit-out projects across the UK and Portugal, Claudia excels at managing document lifecycles, ensuring compliance, and coordinating project activities.

Claudia has overseen health and safety documentation, technical submittals, and drawing management for major projects, including museum refurbishments, hospital extensions, and school developments. Her expertise covers cost planning, quantity surveying, and supporting teams with training and compliance.

Known for accuracy, organisation, and a hands-on approach, Claudia uses industry-standard software and maintains high standards in every aspect of project administration. Her qualifications include the Advanced Professional Certificate/Diploma in Quantity Surveying (IEFP Cert), First Aid at Work, Asbestos Awareness, and Fire Warden training.

At Green Hat, Claudia supports safe, efficient operations and helps teams deliver successful projects through strong administration and a commitment to compliance.

name: Becky Doyle
html:
Becky is our Health & Safety & SSIP Coordinator, and she brings over 10 years of experience in administration and scheduling. As a result, her expertise helps streamline processes, improve team productivity, and ensure smooth operations across every project.

In her role, Becky manages scheduling for safety audits and coordinates essential documentation. Moreover, she supports project teams to meet compliance standards and reduce risks. Because of her proactive approach, clients receive reliable service and consistent communication.

Additionally, Becky enjoys building strong relationships with clients. She is dedicated to making their experience with Green Hat Consulting the best possible. Furthermore, her commitment to excellence reflects our core values of safety, compliance, and client satisfaction.

When Becky isn’t coordinating health and safety services, she focuses on improving workflows and finding innovative solutions. Consequently, her ability to balance efficiency with personalised service sets her apart as a trusted partner in every project.

name: Mark Martin
html:
Mark Martin is an experienced Health & Safety Consultant with over 15 years in the construction sector. He has carried out thousands of site safety visits and provided practical advice to a wide range of trades. As a result, Mark understands the challenges faced on-site and knows how to deliver solutions that work.

His broad experience enables him to identify risks quickly and recommend straightforward improvements. In addition, Mark develops clear, practical strategies that help teams raise safety standards without adding unnecessary complexity. Because of his hands-on approach, clients trust him to provide advice that is both realistic and effective.

Mark’s work goes beyond compliance. He focuses on building a strong safety culture that encourages positive behaviours and reduces incidents. Moreover, his ability to communicate clearly ensures that everyone—from site operatives to senior managers—understands what needs to be done and why.

When Mark isn’t on-site, he supports project teams with training and guidance to maintain best practices. He believes that collaboration and continuous improvement are essential for safe, efficient operations. Consequently, his commitment to health and safety makes him a key contributor to Green Hat Consulting’s mission of creating safer workplaces.

name: Phil Camm
html:
Phil brings a wealth of experience in managing security and safety operations across major infrastructure projects, including national rail electrification and large-scale road construction. His expertise spans the implementation of robust security protocols, comprehensive risk assessments, and the delivery of health and safety training for diverse teams. Phillip’s meticulous approach ensures regulatory compliance and fosters a culture of safety on every site.

With a proven track record in leading incident investigations and producing detailed reports, Phil is adept at promoting safe working environments and supporting project delivery under tight deadlines. His leadership, analytical skills, and commitment to continuous improvement make him a trusted advisor for clients and colleagues alike.

Phil believes that effective communication and teamwork are essential to achieving organisational goals. By engaging stakeholders and motivating teams, he helps deliver projects that are not only compliant but also efficient and resilient. His dedication to high standards and proactive problem-solving ensures that safety remains at the forefront of every project.

name: Thomas Moore
html:
As Green Hat’s Marketing Associate, Thomas is responsible for developing and delivering campaigns that strengthen the company’s presence across the health and safety, compliance, and construction sectors. He leads the creation of digital content, website updates, social media activity, and brand awareness initiatives that support business growth and engage clients across multiple channels.

From digital content creation and social media engagement to market research and brand development, Thomas helps strengthen Green Hat’s presence within the construction and consultancy sectors. He uses data, industry insights, and creative thinking to support marketing campaigns, improve engagement, and identify new opportunities for growth.

Thomas works closely with colleagues across the business to ensure communications remain clear, consistent, and aligned with Green Hat’s values. His proactive mindset, adaptability, and strong communication skills make him a trusted point of contact for both internal teams and external partners.

name: Dylan Bulmer
html:
Dylan Bulmer is a Health & Safety Associate with experience across construction and operational environments. Having worked closely with site teams, he understands the practical challenges faced on-site and provides clear, realistic advice that supports both safety and productivity.

Dylan takes a proactive approach to health and safety, supporting inspections, safe systems of work, risk management, and compliance across projects. His strong organisational skills and attention to detail help ensure safety remains a priority throughout all stages of construction.

Committed to developing his knowledge and expertise, Dylan brings a positive attitude, practical mindset, and collaborative approach to the Green Hat Consulting team.
